description: Read the controls of effects on layers (Effect Controls panel): each control's name, match name, type (number, menu, point, point3d, color, layer, mask, topic, group or custom; checkboxes are numbers 0 or 1), current value, menu choices, range, units, keyframe count and expression

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

effect.description: An effect already on the layer: its name in the Effect Controls panel (e.g. "Gaussian Blur 2"), its match name, or its position (1 = top). Omit for every effect on the layers

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

time.description: Read values at this time (seconds) instead of the current time

name: get_effect_controls
title: Get Effect Controls
